name: All Saints
history: The Church honours in one feast all who have reached heaven, the great multitude which no man could number, most of them known only to God. The feast was fixed on 1 November in the eighth century and is a holy day of obligation.
fast: Until 1955 the day before, 31 October, was kept as a vigil of fasting and abstinence. Some still keep it as a private devotion.
meditation: Holiness is not for a few. Ask one saint to be your companion this month.
prayer: Almighty, eternal God, Who granted us to honor the merits of all Your Saints in a single solemn festival, bestow on us, we beseech You, through their manifold intercession, that abundance of Your mercy for which we yearn. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
